title: sesleria albicans subsp. angustifolia
intro: Sesleria albicans subsp. angustifolia, commonly known as a type of mountain grass, is a plant species in the Poaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Sesleria albicans subsp. angustifolia include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the extent of its therapeutic potential and to fully understand its effects on human health.
